AFFECTED_FIELD_CONTRACT.explanation: Correct typed class can still disagree on field-family versus endpoint naming. Equivalence is not proven by this audit and strict score is unchanged.

CANDIDATE_COMPOSITION_OVERWRITE.explanation: Multiple recognized author/title candidates are assigned to one scalar; later assignment replaces earlier evidence.
CANDIDATE_COMPOSITION_OVERWRITE.remediation: Preserve requirement inventory and resolve multiple referents explicitly.

CONTRADICTION_INPUTS_MISSING.explanation: Frozen operands needed for the contradiction are missing; validate sees only the reduced plan.
CONTRADICTION_INPUTS_MISSING.remediation: Retain both sides of required constraints before consistency checking.

CROSS_FIELD_CONTRADICTION_GAP.explanation: Validator checks numeric bounds, format and category conflicts but has no title/author containment versus broad-text exclusion consistency rule.
CROSS_FIELD_CONTRADICTION_GAP.remediation: Add independently justified cross-field satisfiability checks after extraction.

FINITE_FIELD_RECOGNIZER_GAP.explanation: A known applicable operand has no corresponding captured candidate under the finite field grammar.
FINITE_FIELD_RECOGNIZER_GAP.remediation: Extend source-backed grammatical coverage with separately reviewed examples.

FORMAT_ONLY_SCOPE_GAP.explanation: Format is recognized as PRESENT while the separated format-only wording does not set ONLY.
FORMAT_ONLY_SCOPE_GAP.remediation: Resolve modifier scope across explicit format wording.

HARD_CLAUSE_ROUTED_AS_TOPIC.explanation: Missing structured operands coexist with their clause text in semantic remainder; extraction and remainder dimensions are coupled.
HARD_CLAUSE_ROUTED_AS_TOPIC.remediation: Track clause ownership before semantic remainder assembly.

INCOMPLETE_CUE_GRAMMAR.explanation: Incomplete detection relies on a finite end-anchored residual cue and narrow malformed patterns; captured missing operands are absent from candidates or misread by fallback.
INCOMPLETE_CUE_GRAMMAR.remediation: Recognize clause-local missing operands, preserving blanks through composition.

INTENT_PRECEDENCE_CONTRACT.explanation: Composer gives author precedence over title, while retained gold uses FIND_EXACT. Both operands can remain present. Functional equivalence requires independent contract review.
INTENT_PRECEDENCE_CONTRACT.remediation: Specify combined author/title intent ownership without rewriting historical labels.

NOTICE_OWNERSHIP_AND_REPAIR.explanation: Typed-notice producer is absent and this cohort also lacks all repair/correction notice signals. It is not a representation-only discrepancy.
NOTICE_OWNERSHIP_AND_REPAIR.remediation: Audit typed/advisory ownership and implement traceable bounded repairs separately.

QUOTED_OPERAND_MASKED.explanation: Quoted literals are removed by Source.remaining and rejected by Source.free; title has an explicit ownership exception, subject/negative resolution does not.
QUOTED_OPERAND_MASKED.remediation: Recognize explicit field ownership around protected literals without parsing literal interiors.

RESIDUAL_TEXT_RETAINED.explanation: Normative topic tokens remain in output; extra wrappers/other unresolved text cause strict mismatch. Loss of intent is not established.
RESIDUAL_TEXT_RETAINED.remediation: Specify semantic remainder boundaries with independent review.

SECONDARY_TYPED_SYMPTOM.explanation: Affected-field mismatch accompanies an already wrong typed class; it is not evidence that naming alone caused the error.
SECONDARY_TYPED_SYMPTOM.remediation: Fix primary recognition before interpreting downstream field codes.

TITLE_CLEARS_REMAINDER.explanation: compose assigns semantic_text=None when composing an explicit title, after the legacy remainder has been computed.
TITLE_CLEARS_REMAINDER.remediation: Preserve independent free topical clauses alongside title operands.

UNMODELED_RELATIONAL_AMBIGUITY.explanation: No relational author/title or advisory/mandatory resolution state is emitted; narrow composer ambiguity paths are negation-scope candidates and a bare number.
UNMODELED_RELATIONAL_AMBIGUITY.remediation: Produce unresolved mandatory relation/interpretation records before executable default.

UNRESOLVED_CAUSE.explanation: Frozen mismatch is real under the scoring contract; inspected evidence does not uniquely identify a causal implementation defect.
UNRESOLVED_CAUSE.remediation: Targeted independent semantic/contract investigation before any change.

UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST_UNRECOGNIZED.explanation: Finite unsupported/capability grammar emits no matching strict candidate for the applicable requested field; downstream validate cannot reject an absent operand.
UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST_UNRECOGNIZED.remediation: Represent explicit unsupported mandatory operations even when no enforceable value exists.

UNTAGGED_NUMERIC_FALLBACK.explanation: Captured exact-star candidate replaces a misspelled comparator/range; no repair provenance is present. Equality may invent an extra bound.
UNTAGGED_NUMERIC_FALLBACK.remediation: Bounded operator repair must preserve operator semantics and provenance; otherwise withhold unresolved requirement.
